newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Six stocks fell, five rose and seven were flat in 12.9-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Friday with the WIG 20 index down 1.1 percent to 1,552.4 points.
The remaining six stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 0.7 percent to 136.5 zlotys in a 4.5-million-zloty turnover.
Fourteen National Investment Funds (NFIs) fell and one was flat in 0.9-million-zloty trade.
